# E0518: effect with no operations

An effect is its operations, so one with none can never be performed. Declare its operations.

- Rule: [`handlers.declaring-effect`](../../reference/12-effects.md#handlers.declaring-effect)
- Reported at: the effect's name.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0518:1
effect Audited {
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
effect Audited {
  fn audit(note: str)
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0518_effect_with_no_operations.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0518_effect_with_no_operations.lt):

```text
── EFFECT WITH NO OPERATIONS ─── E0518_effect_with_no_operations.lt:1:8  [E0518]

The effect `Audited` declares no operation, so nothing can perform it:

  1 │ effect Audited {
    │        ^^^^^^^

An effect is its operations, so one with none can never be performed. Declare
its operations.
```
